title: Filtered colimits and derived tensor in the second factor
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $A$ be a commutative $R$-algebra, let $M$ be a cochain complex of $A$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and for a complex $N$ of $R$-modules write $M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}N$ for the value $N\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}M\in D(A)$ of the exact functor $-\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}M:D(R)\to D(A)$ of [lem-pc-derived-tensor-second-factor-functor] (2) [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], so that a morphism $N\to N'$ of complexes of $R$-modules induces an $A$-linear map $H^n(M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}N)\to H^n(M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}N')$. Let $I$ be a filtered category, let $(N_i)_{i\in I}$ be a diagram of complexes of $R$-modules indexed by $I$, and let $N=\varinjlim_i N_i$ be its termwise colimit with coprojections $\iota_j:N_j\to N$. Then for every integer $n$ the maps $H^n(M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}\iota_j)$ induce an isomorphism of $A$-modules $\varinjlim_i H^n(M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}N_i)\to H^n(M\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}N)$, natural in $M$ (for morphisms of complexes of $A$-modules) and in the diagram.

source.place: Tags 06YR and 06Y6: for a K-flat R-resolution E of M, Tot(E (x)_R -) commutes with filtered colimits termwise and cohomology commutes with filtered colimits (exactness of filtered colimits)

proof.text: Use the ordinary-module reduced functorial flat resolution L and its augmentation s from ModuleCat.hasFunctorialFlatResolution and Abelian.LeftResolution.resolutionFunctor. Their source-library proofs show that L(N) is K-flat and s(N) is a quasi-isomorphism. For the restricted fixed complex S(M), put E=L(S(M)) and e=s(S(M)). The computation clause of lem-pc-derived-tensor-second-factor-functor makes the natural comparison epsilon invertible at each L(N). Whiskering epsilon with L, composing with the inverse of the derived image of s, and applying homologyFunctorFactors identifies H(M) naturally with the ordinary cohomology of B(L(-),M). All resolution data come from the proved source construction, not from an unproved existence statement.

Restriction of scalars preserves homology by ModuleCat.preservesHomology_restrictScalars, hence mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso compares homology before and after restriction. Apply lem-pc-mixed-tensor-restriction-comparison to identify the restricted B(L(N),M) with L(N) tensor S(M), naturally in N. Tensoring e with the K-flat L(N) gives a quasi-isomorphism L(N) tensor E -> L(N) tensor S(M); tensoring s(N) with the K-flat E gives a quasi-isomorphism L(N) tensor E -> N tensor E. The source kFlat.whiskerLeft and kFlat.whiskerRight are precisely these assertions. Apply cohomology, use NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app, and compose the resulting natural isomorphisms. This is the private proved balancedModel lemma: H(M) followed by restriction is naturally isomorphic to tensorRight E followed by ordinary degree-n homology.

The tensor-Hom adjunction and braiding give colimit preservation by tensorRight of every coefficient module. The proved source instance Functor.instPreservesColimitsOfShapeFlipObjMap₂HomologicalComplex in BifunctorColimits then gives preservation by tensorRight E on unbounded complexes. ModuleCat AB5, obtained from exact filtered colimits of abelian groups, makes the filtered colimit functor preserve homology. For a diagram F of short complexes, let K be its image under ShortComplex.functorEquivalence.inverse. The evaluation homology isomorphisms identify K.homology with F followed by short-complex homology; K.mapHomologyIso colim identifies its colimit with the homology of the degreewise colimit. Their naturality at the colimit coprojections proves preservation of the actual colimit cocone. Evaluation in the three adjacent degrees makes shortComplexFunctor preserve colimits. Compose and transport via HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctorIso to obtain preservation by ordinary complex homology. Thus tensorRight E followed by degree-n homology preserves filtered colimits.

proof.text: Transport preservation in step 3 through the natural isomorphism of step 2. Restriction of scalars preserves colimits and reflects isomorphisms, so reflectsColimitsOfShape_of_reflectsIsomorphisms and preservesColimitsOfShape_of_reflects_of_preserves show that H(M) itself preserves filtered colimits. The canonical map colimit.post is consequently invertible. Its coprojection equation is colimit.ι_post. For naturality in M, apply colimit.hom_ext, colimit.ι_map_assoc and colimit.ι_post, then use naturality of the whiskered T.map g. Naturality in diagrams is the symmetry of colimit.map_post. These prove all four clauses of the original Lean statement, without any change in coefficients, universes, or hypotheses.

lean.statement: theorem filteredColimit_derivedTensor_cohomology (f : R →+* A) (I : Type u) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (n : ℤ) : let QR := (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) let T := Classical.choose (exists_derivedTensor_second_factor_functor f).2 let H := fun M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ ↦ QR ⋙ T.obj M ⋙ homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) n (∀ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (N : I ⥤ CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ), IsIso (colimit.post N (H M))) ∧ (∀ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (N : I ⥤ CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (j : I), colimit.ι (N ⋙ H M) j ≫ colimit.post N (H M) = (H M).map (colimit.ι N j)) ∧ (∀ (M M' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (g : M ⟶ M') (N : I ⥤ CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ), let η := whiskerRight (whiskerLeft QR (T.map g)) (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) n) colim.map (whiskerLeft N η) ≫ colimit.post N (H M') = colimit.post N (H M) ≫ η.app (colimit N)) ∧ (∀ (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (N N' : I ⥤ CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (a : N ⟶ N'), colim.map (whiskerRight a (H M)) ≫ colimit.post N' (H M) = colimit.post N (H M) ≫ (H M).map (colim.map a))

reviewed_lean.note: f:R→+*A for R-algebra A; arbitrary M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat A) ℤ; M⊗ᴸN = (Classical.choose dep.2).obj M applied to Q N, the landed H1 existential functor (T.map pinned by ε on K-flat models); I small IsFiltered, full diagram N, termwise colimit N with ι; all n:ℤ; canonical map colimit.post with ι-equation, IsIso in ModuleCat A; naturality in g:M⟶M' via T.map g and in a:N⟶N'
